crossRefs.note: Pharaoh king of Egypt, with his servants, his princes, and all his people;
Yahweh’s word that came to Jeremiah the prophet concerning the Philistines, before Pharaoh struck Gaza.
Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,
“Son of man, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon caused his army to serve a great service against Tyre. Every head was made…
Yahweh says: “For three transgressions of Tyre, yes, for four, I will not turn away its punishment; because they…
Yahweh says: “For three transgressions of Moab, yes, for four, I will not turn away its punishment; because he burned…
He also rebelled against king Nebuchadnezzar, who had made him swear by God; but he stiffened his neck, and hardened…
But he rebelled against him in sending his ambassadors into Egypt, that they might give him horses and many people.…

people.name: Ammon
people.line: An ancient nation and its capital city, enemies of Israel.

people.name: Edom
people.line: Descendants of Esau; enemy nation southeast of Israel

people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

people.name: Moab
people.line: Ancient kingdom east of the Dead Sea in Jordan

people.name: Tyre
people.line: A major Phoenician port city, known for its trade

people.name: Zedekiah
people.line: Last king of Judah before the Babylonian exile

translations.web: Then send them to the king of Edom, to the king of Moab, to the king of the children of Ammon, to the king of Tyre, and to the king of Sidon, by the hand of the messengers who come to Jerusalem to Zedekiah king of Judah.
translations.bsb: Send word to the kings of Edom, Moab, Ammon, Tyre, and Sidon through the envoys who have come to Jerusalem to Zedekiah king of Judah.
translations.kjv: And send them to the king of Edom, and to the king of Moab, and to the king of the Ammonites, and to the king of Tyrus, and to the king of Zidon, by the hand of the messengers which come to Jerusalem unto Zedekiah king of Judah;
